verdict.rationale: Omarchy is an Arch-based distro, so official OS variants (flavors) are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no official variants with different desktop environments. It describes a single Hyprland-based setup, and a user notes the install has "no bootloader or WM choices." Swappable themes, terminals, and editors within the one system are adjacent customization, not official OS variants.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can choose among official variants of the OS with different desktop environments and default apps
